scripts/validate_twelve_loop_gap_evidence.py enforces seven fail-closed rejection rules. future_timestamp rejects any evidence_cut_at, validated_at, observed_at, record_log recorded_at, required-check completed_at, or command observation timestamp later than the check instant. head_binding rejects a bare commit sha, a stale content digest, or a mutated bound artifact. record_log_ordering rejects non-increasing sequences and backwards timestamps. checks_bound_to_commits rejects a check on an unrecorded head. current_delivery_checks rejects a manifest with no named delivery receipt, a superseded receipt, a receipt whose bound_content_digest does not equal validated_head_sha, a receipt missing any of the three required workflows, or a check set that lands only on superseded heads. mutable_observation_binding rejects any gh pr / gh run / gh api command entry that does not bind each fact to a 40-hex head and an observed_at.
Run against the rejected v4 manifest with --now 2026-07-26T21:49:00Z, the validator returns exactly the Human/Ops findings: two future_timestamp rejections and one head_binding rejection.

scripts/test_validate_twelve_loop_gap_evidence.py pins each rule with a mutation test and asserts the delivered manifest passes all seven, so a future recut that reintroduces any defect fails in the regression suite rather than in review.
